sentences.en: Yanni and Skura's love affair abruptly came to an end.
sentences.zh: 阎尼和斯库拉的爱情关系突然结束了。

sentences.en: His untidy room announced that he had abruptly departed.
sentences.zh: 他凌乱的房间表明他突然离开了。

sentences.en: Discontinuing duloxetine, especially when done abruptly, commonly leads to withdrawal effects.
sentences.zh: 停用杜洛西汀，尤其是突然停药时，通常会导致戒断反应。

senses.zh: 突然地；意外地；（言谈举止）唐突地
